answer.rationale: Finance's hard 18% reduction is incompatible with renewing incumbent at their current terms (and they have refused to reopen price). Memory c2 records a successful switch to a low-cost primary last year with quick onboarding and clean invoicing; that experience supports trying a new primary now. With only ~14 days before the contract expires and no auto-renew, the window to negotiate a switch is already narrow; I would begin parallel conversations with the alternative vendor and the incumbent so the incumbent can still be held as the fallback. Before committing fully, I would run a guarded, time-boxed pilot (a small fraction of volume on the new vendor) rather than a full cutover, because the line is running at 94% of committed volume with no buffer and the constraint is end-to-end delivery risk, not headline unit price.
